title: A root pointer names its owning group path, and a pointer that names only a team is read as a group one level deep
goal: kbroot.py add-remote takes --group G1/.../GN (letters, digits, `_ . -` per level) beside --team, writes `group:` into the pointer, and kbroot.py list and kb_status show group=PATH for a root that names one; a pointer with only `team: NAME` is read as group NAME; a group that is no path of ids is refused, exit 2, naming the pointer; KB-Teams trailers are unchanged

run:
import sys,os,tempfile,subprocess
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); w=os.path.join(d,"w"); subprocess.run(["git","clone","-q","--local",".",w],check=True)
run=lambda *x: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbroot.py",*x],cwd=w,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
r1=run("add-remote","team-ops","--url","https://gitlab.corp.example.com/corp/ops/kb.git","--prefix","TOX","--team","ops","--group","corp/ops","--access","fetch")
r2=run("add-remote","team-dev","--url","https://gitlab.corp.example.com/corp/dev/kb.git","--prefix","TDX","--team","dev","--access","fetch")
r3=run("add-remote","team-bad","--url","https://gitlab.corp.example.com/x/kb.git","--prefix","TBX","--team","x","--group","corp//ops","--access","fetch")
ls=run("list").stdout
assert r1.returncode==0 and r2.returncode==0 and r3.returncode==2, (r1,r2,r3)
assert "group=corp/ops" in ls and "group=dev" in ls, ls

write group: into every pointer that names only a team

gates.answer: read at load time, nothing rewritten

gates.question: kb_status's roots line (kb_mcp.py) is outside this item's touches: leave it showing team= only here, or widen the touches to kb_mcp.py?
options: leave kb_mcp.py unchanged, widen touches and finish it
gates.recommendation: leave kb_mcp.py unchanged, widen touches and finish it
gates.reason: the goal names kb_status, one line at kb_mcp.py:619 prints group=PATH from Root.group
